_readme: Sample inbound order emails for Module H. Date tokens like {{DATE+1}} are replaced with real dates relative to today when the intake job runs, so the sample stays current. Attachments reference files under samples/attachments (CSV, XLSX, PDF); a mailbox connector would pass contentBase64 instead.

emails.subject: Fuel order - Pit 4 - PO LSA-4488
emails.body:
Hi RPG team,

Please schedule a delivery.

Customer: Lone Star Aggregates
Location: Pit 4 - Ennis, TX
Product: Dyed ULSD
Gallons: 7,500

Notes: Call the gate 30 minutes before arrival.

Thanks,
Ray Hollis
